description.zh:
该参数用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。参数值由客户端生成，保证在不同请求间唯一。

该参数值由 ASCII 字符组成，最长不超过 64 个字符，不能包含非 ASCII 字符。
description.en:
This parameter ensures the idempotence of the request to prevent duplicate submissions. The value is generated by the client and must be unique across different requests.

The value consists of ASCII characters, contains no more than 64 characters, and must not include non-ASCII characters.

description.zh: 实例 ID。可调用 DescribeDBInstances 获取。
description.en: Instance ID. You can obtain it by invoking DescribeDBInstances.

description.zh: 要查询的数据库版本。若指定instanceId，则使用实例的版本覆盖此参数
description.en: Database version to query. If instanceId is specified, the instance's version overwrites this parameter.

descriptions.zh:
适用引擎：
* SQLServer（仅支持2016及更早版本）
descriptions.en:
Supported engine:  
* SQL Server (supports only 2016 and earlier versions)
